intent: Check catalog for a Bahco Workshop BAH 3VZ-SPH Hammer Measuring and Cutting Tool variant whose tool_type property is 'measuring tape'.

params.family_name: Bahco Workshop BAH 3VZ-SPH Hammer Measuring and Cutting Tool

success_criteria: Answer states YES/NO whether a matching variant exists in catalog
If found, references exact product record_path
Match constrained to brand=Bahco, family line, and property tool_type=measuring tape

args.stdin: SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.product_name, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_variant_properties pvp ON pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'tool_type' AND pvp.property_value_text = :tool_type WHERE pv.brand = :brand AND pv.series = :series AND pv.model = :model AND pv.product_name LIKE '%Hammer Measuring and Cutting Tool%';

agents_md_constraints.rule: When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response. This is how the agent will know how to style the response.
When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
When answering availability questions - answer should reference products that are available, but should not reference unavailable products.

answer_template.message: {'<YES>' if match else '<NO>'} {'Found ' + match.product_name + ' (' + match.product_sku + ') at ' + match.record_path + ' — in the Bahco Workshop BAH 3VZ-SPH Hammer Measuring and Cutting Tool line with tool_type measuring tape.' if match else 'No Bahco Workshop BAH 3VZ-SPH Hammer Measuring and Cutting Tool with tool_type measuring tape exists in catalog.'}
